topics.name: Ingest Release Watch digest
topics.trigger: Handoff payload from the explorer (/copilot-studio?digest=1) or the phrase analyze release watch.
topics.instructions: Accept only in use and referenced rows. Drop unused inventory (ENT-17) and unused-product flags. Require a Microsoft source_url on every row.

topics.name: Emit TicketAnalysis
topics.instructions: For each remaining flag emit a TicketAnalysis row: title, description, url, area, severity, dataverseValue (211460000–211460003), effective_date, change_type (Feature|Deprecated), is_deferable, system_impact, reasoning, should_create_ticket, matched_solutions. Do not invent deprecation claims beyond the source_url page.

topics.name: Create Case tickets for System Administrator
topics.instructions: Create incident (Case) records. Set title and description from TicketAnalysis. Set the TicketAnalysis severity choice to dataverseValue. Assign owner or queue to System Administrator. Do not create cases for unused rows.

tools.name: Rate TicketAnalysis
tools.input: Filtered digest row + Contoso inventory labels

tools.name: Create incident
tools.note: Configured by the admin in Copilot Studio after publish. The explorer never calls Dataverse.
